body: Part of e553ce, needed for the iOS backend. skywaved ships Linux only; Linux-specific code sits in process.rs, shell/host.rs, disk.rs, server/limits.rs, identity.rs, main.rs (reaping, the shell sandbox, disk check, socket options). Port each, add a darwin release artefact, and document running it as a per-user launchd agent (a booted simulator wants a logged-in session).
title: screen 8: run skywaved on macOS
